_basis: Compliant design example: value starts in under a minute, no non-value steps before it, questions adapt and visibly change the first value, paywall after value, retention read by activation and TTV bucket, outside/inside pair recorded and matching.

definition.decision_informed: shorten or reorder the flow when median TTV exceeds 60s
definition.value_complete_event: first affirmation listened to the end (3-beat completion)
definition.value_start_event: first personalised affirmation on screen, playback starts
